@passportCoverBrand.description: The app's name in foil letters on the Passport's cover (the brand, the same in every language).

@passportCoverTitle.description: The word printed in foil under the globe on the Passport's cover.

passportCoverOwn: Places where you left a capsule

@passportCoverOwn.description: The line on the cover of your own Passport.

@passportCoverFriend.description: The line on the cover of a friend's Passport; name is their first name.

@passportStampsSince.description: Under the Passport's cover after the countries and towns: the day of the first stamp ("12 Mar 2025").

@passportTapToOpen.description: Hint under the Passport's closed cover.

passportStampsHint: Tap a stamp to see more

@passportStampsHint.description: Hint under a Passport page of town stamps.

passportVisasHint: Tap a visa to see its towns

@passportVisasHint.description: Hint under a Passport page of visas (one per country).

@passportFriendHint.description: Hint under the You and a friend page; name is the friend's first name.

@passportPhotoLabel.description: Printed at the top of the Passport's photo page in the app's five languages, as on a real passport (the same in every language).

@passportSurname.description: Field label on the Passport's photo page: the last word of the person's name.

@passportGivenNames.description: Field label on the Passport's photo page: the person's name without the surname.

@passportName.description: Field label on the Passport's photo page when the person's name is one word.

@passportUsername.description: Field label on the Passport's photo page: the @username.

@passportHomeTown.description: Field label on the Passport's photo page: the home town from the profile.

@passportCapsulesLabel.description: Small caps label under a number on a Passport page: capsules.

@passportCountriesLabel.description: Small caps label under a number on a Passport page: countries.

@passportTownsLabel.description: Small caps label under a number on a Passport page: towns.

@passportFirstEntry.description: On a visa and on the photo page's stamp: the day of the first capsule in a country.

@passportVisasLabel.description: Printed at the top of a Passport page of visas (one per country).

@passportVisa.description: On a visa in the Passport, before the country code ("VISA · PL").

@passportInLater.description: On a visa: label above the country's towns and capsules in the app.

@passportYearLabel.description: Printed at the top of the Passport's last page: the current year in places.

@passportNewLabel.description: Small caps label under a number on the Your year page: countries first entered this year.

@passportNewThisYear.description: Label on the Your year page above the countries first entered this year.

passportYearMonthsNote: Each country at its latest visit this year

@passportYearMonthsNote.description: Note under the month line on the Your year page.

@passportStampFirstHere.description: In a town's stamp sheet: the day of the first capsule in that town.

@passportStampFirstIn.description: In a town's stamp sheet or a visa's sheet: the day of the first capsule in the country (the app does not know the day per town).

@passportEmptyTitle.description: Title of an empty Passport's stamps page.

passportEmptyBody: Leave a capsule somewhere and its town is stamped here.

@passportEmptyBody.description: Text of an empty Passport's stamps page.

@passportEmptyFriend.description: Text of a friend's empty Passport; name is their first name.

@passportMakeCapsule.description: Button on an empty Passport: opens the camera.

@passportShare.description: The share button in the Passport's header (screen readers): sends the open page as a picture.

passportShareText: A page from a Later passport

@passportShareText.description: Text sent with a shared picture of a Passport page.

@passportTogetherLabel.description: Printed at the top of the You and a friend page of a friend's Passport; name is their first name in capitals.

@passportTogetherBoth.description: On the You and a friend page: the countries ("2 countries") and towns ("3 towns") both people have a stamp in.

@passportBothLabel.description: Small caps label on the You and a friend page above the towns both people have.

@passportOnlyThem.description: Small caps label on the You and a friend page above the countries only the friend has; name is their first name in capitals.

@passportOnlyYou.description: Small caps label on the You and a friend page above the countries only you have.

@passportNothingShared.description: On the You and a friend page when the two have no town in common.

@passportNone.description: On the You and a friend page under ONLY YOU or ONLY <name> when the list is empty.
